records.title: Adopt tooling follows symlinks planted in the adopted repo
records.boundary: Author of an adopted repo -> adopter's files outside that repo
records.fix: Fixed 2026-11-07: symlinked or outside destinations are refused (lstat walk + O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL), no-follow chmod walk, repo strings sanitised; regression tests AdoptSymlinks; sandbox repro re-run shows no effect

records.title: PR preview job shared the production Cloudflare token (repo-level secret, confirmed by owner)
records.boundary: Same-repo PR branch author -> production Worker (bypasses the production environment gate)
records.fix: Code fixed (ADR 0003): preview job uses environment "preview" and skips without its own token. OWNER: move CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from repo secrets to environment "production" (deployment branches: main), then delete the repo secret

records.title: Agent deploy guard misses wrapped and alternative deploy commands
records.boundary: Agent (possibly prompt-injected) -> direct production deploy outside git
records.fix: Fixed 2026-11-07: shell-executed strings and heredocs are checked, the regex covers wrangler@ver and versions deploy, and deny rules were added; regression test in BashPolicy

hardening.note: Add a top-level 'permissions: contents: read' to ci.yml; pin the playwright version; pin actions to commit SHAs and wranglerVersion to the lockfile version; set persist-credentials: false on checkout.
No HSTS in public/_headers (add it once a custom domain is used); the Worker's /version and /health responses miss nosniff; set workers_dev and preview_urls explicitly in wrangler.jsonc.

Narrow the Bash(python3 scripts/*) and Bash(bash scripts/*) allow rules; git diff*/log* allow rules permit --output writes; .factory/HANDOFF.md is tracked and injected into agent context without provenance.
factory.json pins the external skills to the mutable 'main' (security-audit-run's 'pinned ref' claim is wrong); install-codegraph.sh installs unpinned npm and curl|sh.

dashboard.py does not check the URL scheme of production_url; adopt.py trusts a shipped docs/adoption-scan.json for shell commands; adopt_scan runs git with the target's .git/config; /tmp paths in pre-push and context_watch are predictable (deferred unit).

positive: Strict CSP (script-src 'self', frame-ancestors 'none', form-action 'none'); challenges are served as text/plain
No DOM sinks: copy.js uses static data-copy values and textContent; no inline scripts (enforced by check_page.py)
The Worker reflects no request data; there are no CORS headers, cookies or redirects
No pull_request_target; production deploys run only on push to main behind the production environment, using the lockfile
Dashboard output is HTML-escaped; no secrets are tracked; .env* and .dev.vars are ignored and denied
limits: Quick profile: one hunter wave and one critic; not exhaustive
